name: base
title: Haze UI base (tokens + every component wrapper)
description: One-command setup of the whole haze-ui design system: theme tokens plus a thin wrapper for every styled component, pulled in through registryDependencies.
author: wmzy <https://github.com/wmzy>
docs:
One command installs the entire haze-ui design system: the theme tokens (this item ships the token-activation wrapper) plus a thin re-export wrapper for every styled component — 121 registry items pulled in through `registryDependencies`, resolved recursively by the CLI. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add wmzy/haze-ui/base ``` Each component wrapper lands at `components/ui/haze/.tsx` and re-exports its component from the `haze-ui` npm package (installed automatically), importing its stylesheet — no other setup is needed. ## Theming This wrapper re-exports the 'lightTheme' (or 'darkTheme'), 'spacing' and 'typography' classes from 'haze-ui' and imports 'haze-ui/css/tokens.css'. Activate the design tokens by applying the classes to a root element: ```jsx import { lightTheme, spacing, typography } from 'haze-ui'; // on or any root container — darkTheme is a drop-in swap
…
``` Details: https://github.com/wmzy/haze-ui/tree/main/registry
